svg.text: R2’s taper plus a swell fading out over the bottom 200 units. The mark has no flare — its legs measure exactly linear, 5.078 pt at the
foot to 3.278 at the counter apex in even steps — so this is an addition, not something the drawing asks for.
It is not the A’s alone. R2 is the field every stem and diagonal reads, so a flare there flares the whole face:
At +16 the A reads sturdier and so does everything else — the H, T and I gain visible slab-like feet, which is a different face.
